payload.entry: Closed by sase-zu.8.5 acceptance. agents_machine_pushdown has no flag definition, registry entry, schema key or executable branch (grep over src/tests/tools/Justfile is empty); machine pushdown is unconditional. Evidence on sase-core pin 23f19f0 (index schema 30): production oracle zero-diff regressions for conflicting source/owner provenance under machine:apollo, mixed-provenance family trees for both polarities, meta-over-done precedence and post-index owner repair; not machine:apollo stays on the bounded window (13k synthetic 101.1 ms p50, athena real 1002.4 ms p50 vs 10866.4 ms source scan). Published in docs/perf_runbook.md.
